thag10.6:1.1: Vivittaṃ appanigghosaṃ vāḷamiganisevitaṃ seve senāsanaṃ bhikkhu paṭisallānakāraṇā. || ||
thag10.6:2.1: saṃkārapuñjā āhatvā susānā rathiyāhi ca tato saṃghāṭikaṃ katvā lūkhaṃ dhāreyya cīvaraṃ. || ||
thag10.6:3.1: nīcaṃ manaṃ karitvāna sapadānaṃ kulā kulaṃ piṇḍikāya care bhikkhu guttadvāro susaṃvuto. || ||
thag10.6:4.1: lūkhena pi ca santusse, nāññaṃ patthe rasaṃ bahuṃ; rasesu anugiddhassa jhāne na ramatī mano. || ||
thag10.6:5.1: appiccho c' eva santuṭṭho pavivitto vase muni, asaṃsaṭṭho gahaṭṭhehi anāgārehi c' ūbhayaṃ. || ||
thag10.6:6.1: yathā jaḷo ca mūgo ca attānaṃ dassaye tathā; nātivelaṃ pabhāseyya saṃghamajjhamhi paṇḍito. || ||
thag10.6:7.1: na so upavade kañci, upaghātaṃ vivajjaye, saṃvuto pātimokkhasmiṃ mattaññū c' assa bhojane. || ||
thag10.6:8.1: suggahītanimitt' assa cittass' uppādakovido, samathaṃ anuyuñjeyya kālena ca vipassanaṃ. || ||
thag10.6:9.1: viriyasātaccasampanno yuttayogo sadā siyā, na ca appatvā dukkhass' antaṃ vissāsam eyya paṇḍito. || ||
thag10.6:10.1: evaṃ viharamānassa suddhikāmassa bhikkhuno khīyanti āsavā sabbe nibbutiñ cādhigacchatīti. || || Upaseno Vaṅgantaputto thero.
